CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  June 28, 2022

•  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

•  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Absent:  None
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

ITEM 1: DRB MINUTES - June 14, 2022

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve the consent calendar.
 •  The second was by Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2: 2720 West Valley Boulevard
This application is to update signage at an existing commercial building for the business known as
"Omeo Suites".
Applicant: Lavender Fung, Signs Express Co.

  1
 RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

ACTION MINUTES:
There were no comments by the Board.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve Item 2 as submitted.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

ITEM 3: 1600 Cabrillo Avenue
This application is for a one-story addition and a porch to an existing single-family residence.
Applicant: Evan Chiao, Equitas Investments LLC

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for continuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The staff report was given and the applicant was present.

The applicant stated that other neighbors have simple roofs and are also located on corners.

Mr. Abe stated that even though the neighbors may be on corner properties the concerns stated on
this project are specific to this design.

The applicant shared his revised designs for information purposes only. He showed a revised roof
plan and minor building changes. There was considerable discussion regarding the lack of
modulation and lack of architectural style. The drawings shown were not adequate to evaluate the
design and how it differed from the current submittal.

The owner was present and asked questions as to the appropriateness of material and to the issue of
net floor area. This was explained by Mr. Abe stating that the stone material was inconsistent with
the architectural style and that a net floor area for the design can be maintained regardless of
proposed building modulation.

The Board concurred that the drawings shown were heading in the right direction but that the
applicant needed to work with staff to address concerns and that complete drawings were required
to resubmit.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application to allow redesign.

  2
   •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

ITEM 4: 1216 South Garfield Avenue
This application is for exterior alterations to an existing multi-tenant commercial building.
Applicant: Tim Wong, TNCK LLC

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for continuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present. He stated that he was unaware they needed DRB approval.

There were no public comments.

Hernandez stated that she was amenable to keeping the blue color and pairing another color instead
of the green with the purpose of mitigating the impact of the overall palette. This would be
considered but that she would need to see the proposal.

It was also stated that the quality of the paint job was important. Mr. Abe stated that a portion of the
building was originally a ribbed metal siding.

Tsai stated that the wall on the property line is not shown and questioned if it would be painted. All
sides of the building are not documented. Udani stated that the applicant needs to propose a new
palette and provide adequate documentation to communicate his intention.

Mr. Abe stated that to save the applicant his application fee the Board could continue the project.
Udani stated that he has seen the building but it was recommended that the other members visit the
site.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

ADJOURNMENT:

There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:30 P.M. to July 12, 2022.

  3
 MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:30 P.M.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 12th day of July, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
